observations.behavior: Adds a new method `get_retryable_errors` returning a set containing the string 'Max retries exceeded with url'. This is used to classify transient connection failures as retryable rather than permanent errors.
observations.posthog_connection: This classification prevents transient Sentry API connection failures (e.g., read timeouts, exhausted connection pools) from being reported as permanent bugs to PostHog's error tracking.
